poultry.context: Annual egg production table; egg-type ducks including Indian Runner and Khaki Campbell.

quail.title: University of Minnesota — A Guide to Alternative Poultry Production
quail.context: Fig. 3 footnote, lines 673–676. Japanese quail strains are selected for egg production or for meat.
